blurb:
Our vessel "Hokulani" is a beautiful and spacious custom built sailing trimaran specifically designed for a comfortable ride in Hawaiian waters. What makes Hokulani unique from every other tour boat operating in Waikiki, is that she was designed with three separate hulls to provide an exceptionally smooth, fast, and stable ride even when conditions get rough.

At 41 feet long, and 26 feet wide, her deck provides almost 1,000 square feet of room to move about on, while her open concept provides unobstructed open air views from almost anywhere on board. 

With 2 netted seating areas, 5 separate bench seating areas, and one extremely comfortable shaded lounge area that our crew affectionately refers to as "the nook", you'll always have access to a comfortable seat to enjoy a wonderful view from.
